title: Counting Friends Fun Day
description: Join our friends Maya, Jaden, and Ava as they count together to five! Sing along with this fun nursery rhyme!
characters: Maya: warm brown skin, afro puffs, yellow sundress; Jaden: medium brown skin, buzz cut, blue shirt and green pants; Ava: light brown skin, curly ponytail, pink dress

lines: One little friend is laughing free
Two hands are clapping for me
verses.scene: Maya sitting on a mat with Jaden standing behind her, both smiling at the camera

lines: Three feet are tapping out the beat
Yes yes, we can count together
verses.scene: Ava joining in with a tambourine and dancing around Maya and Jaden

lines: Four bubbles floating through the air
We're counting all our friends who care
verses.scene: Maya blowing soap bubbles while Jaden catches them

lines: Five happy faces smiling at you
Yes yes, we can count together
verses.scene: All three friends standing together with big smiles and holding hands
